QuestInfo.name: Notice from the Excavation Team
QuestInfo.0: Someone's telling me there's an urgent notice posted on the bulletin board at the excavation camp.
QuestInfo.1: I read a notice posted on the bulletin board at #m10004133#. It said that many members of the excavation team had been injured by a skeleton army that appeared in the Tomb of the Ruins, and asked for someone to defeat #r#o65# x100 and #o66# x100#k, then bring #b#t4000154# x60 and #t4000155# x60#k to #b#p516##k as proof.
QuestInfo.2: I defeated the skeletons in the Tomb of the Ruins, collected their bones and bandages, and brought them to #p516#, a member of the excavation team.

0.0: - Notice -\n\nLately, there have been people being injured at the hands of the Skeletons that are popping up from the tomb area of the excavation site. We're waiting for that brave someone to show courage and defeat them. #rEliminate 100 #o65#s and 100 #o66#s, then report it to #b#p516##k the excavator.
0.1:
* #rThe Reward#k

* While reporting to #p516#, please offer the following items as evidence.

1.0: You must have seen the notice board. Show me the evidence. Hmm... this seems legit. I'll keep these bones for future research. Thank you for helping the Excavation Team out. Here's the reward like I promised.

yes.0: We appreciate your effort. Thank you for helping us out.
